status: Exploratory addition after original and supplemental results were known; fixed before calculating origin-deletion results; not preregistered
author: H. Esad Kay
rule: For every observed origin in every market/horizon cell, remove that complete paired origin, then recompute equal-origin actual and nominal mean losses and their ratio. Do not delete individual service rows or missing calendar months.
relative_reduction: 1 - mean(nominal_loss) / mean(actual_loss); missing for zero baseline or empty retained sample
concentration: Report each omitted origin signed actual-minus-nominal loss difference divided by the full-cell sum of signed differences; undefined if the denominator is zero. This is an influence diagnostic, not a confidence interval, jackknife standard error or refitted model.
reporting: Export every deletion, not a selected set; summarize min/max and associated omitted months; retain observed-origin and paired-case counts. Positive single-deletion results do not rule out concentration across multiple origins.
